text:
Hey!
Got any coin to spare?
zh:
嘿！
有闲钱赏几个吗？

text: I lost my permit to the capital last night at the tavern.
zh: 昨晚我在酒馆把进王都的通行证弄丢了。

text: Now the guards won't let me in, and I've got nowhere to sleep tonight.
zh: 现在卫兵不让我进城，今晚我连个睡觉的地方都没有。

text: Why do you need the money?

Ah well.
I'll be nearby the capital in case you feel like tossing a coin to a poor bastard like me.
zh:
唉，好吧。
我就在王都附近，万一你哪天愿意赏我这个可怜虫几个钱呢。

text: Well, I guess I'll have to rent a room at Rair's tavern. Not exactly a bargain.
zh: 唉，看来我只能去莱尔的酒馆租个房间了。那价钱可不便宜。

text: That should be enough to get me into the city.

Hey!
Got any coin to spare?
zh:
嘿！
有闲钱赏几个吗？
